summaries.Romania: Romania faces critical policy decisions on public sector salaries and education reform, while managing regional security concerns with drone detections near Moldova. Infrastructure and energy challenges dominate alongside healthcare innovations making headlines.
summaries.Healthcare: AI is reshaping clinical workflows and administrative processes, while cancer vaccines and rural healthcare expansion signal major innovation shifts. Cost pressures persist as employers brace for 9.5% healthcare increases and behavioral health services expand.
summaries.Tech: Apple prepares major retail and product launches including M6 iMacs and new Home products, while AI safety concerns mount as models demonstrate increasingly autonomous capabilities. Humanoid robots break speed records, and foldable iPhone Ultra generates early enthusiasm.

items.line: Romania's salary law debate reaches critical stage with presidential mediation, risking EU rating downgrade if not resolved before election year.

items.title: STAT+: Inside Moderna and Merck’s cancer vaccine triumph
items.snippet: Moderna and Merck's wild gambit on a cancer vaccine appears to have worked, despite big doubts, logistical challenges, and pandemic-era complications.

items.title: Epic's Seth Howard on leadership changes and the company's vision to power AI across the health system
items.snippet: Seth Howard views Epic's AI strategy as a continuation of a long-term roadmap, not a sudden shift, even as agile healthcare AI startups jump into the market to offer specialized tools.
items.line: Epic's expanded AI agent platform with automation capabilities positions EHRs as foundational infrastructure for clinical AI deployment.

items.title: Epic expands AI ambitions with agent platform, Cosmos-powered predictions and workflow automation
items.snippet: As healthcare organizations rapidly adopt artificial intelligence technologies, electronic health record giant Epic aims to be the foundational layer, embedding AI and automation into clinical, operational and administrative workflows.
items.line: Epic embeds AI throughout EHR workflows for coding, chart review, and predictions, accelerating healthcare's AI adoption baseline.

items.title: Report: Apple launching updated iMac with M6 chip and new colors later this year
items.snippet: After a two year hiatus, Apple is working on a new iMac with the M6 chipset and updated color options, per Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman. It should release “before the end of the year.”
items.line: M6 iMac with new colors signals Apple's continued refresh cycle while addressing 2-year product gap in desktop segment.

items.title: Here’s what people who have used the iPhone Ultra like most
items.snippet:

items.line: iPhone Ultra foldable device generates positive internal feedback, indicating Apple may finally enter the foldable market after years of skepticism.
